title: juglans laciniata
intro: Juglans laciniata, commonly known as Cutleaf Walnut or Manchurian Walnut, is a deciduous tree species native to East Asia, characterized by its distinctive cutleaf foliage and edible nuts. The health benefits of Juglans laciniata include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant, due in part to its rich content of polyphenols and flavonoids. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Juglans laciniata include juglone, a phenolic compound with potential anticancer and antimicrobial properties, as well as other polyphenols, flavonoids, and fatty acids.
